content: LIBERO transformers dependency: LIBERO/libero/lifelong/utils.py uses only AutoModel, AutoTokenizer from transformers for language task embedding (GPT-2, CLIP, RoBERTa). These APIs are stable and backward compatible across transformers 4.21.1 to 4.40.1. No LIBERO simulation code (used in Phase 1 ENV-02) imports transformers at all — transformers is only needed for LIBERO lifelong TRAINING (lifelong/utils.py). Phase 1 only uses OffScreenRenderEnv for rendering check, which does not import transformers. Therefore transformers==4.40.1 override is safe for Phase 1 because the simulation env creation path has NO transformers dependency.
